agent.outcome: landed - decision at /imagine/design/spacing/decision.md, audit at /imagine/design/spacing/audit/ (20 before/after pairs at 3440). Levels: spacing-tight 0.6 / regular 1 / spacing-airy 1.6 on one inherited --spacing token (1 : 1.67 : 2.67; the 'hardly noticeable' three were templates.css's 0.88 : 1 : 1.06 and moved type not space). The 3440 scale: three ramps replace the two flat clamps - --pad-ramp clamp(1em, 2.6% - 1.1em, 4em), --gap-ramp clamp(1em, 1.5vw - 0.3em, 2.6em), --flow-ramp clamp(2em, 1.4vw + 0.8em, 3em): 1280 floors held to the pixel, 70 / 46 / 54px at 3440 (was 36 / 24 / 36). Control rule: a chip/button/link-card/summary hugs its content (fit-content, 0.6-1em side padding), a list row may span, an inline text link is not a control (retired 4,419 noise findings). The owner's 981px control was an unstyled <details>: framework.css:384 was the only rule touching summary sitewide - 962px over 137px of ink; summary strips 45 -> 0, page-preview-link strips 432 -> 0, findings 9,177 -> 7,929. HONEST: sitewide median at 3440 9.7 -> 9.7px unmoved, because on 65 of 91 pages the median gap is a constant inside a component; on the 26 pages that read tokens 30.8 -> 48.6px (1.2x -> 1.8x growth). Regressions named: div.page-preview reads as a strip 54x (the emptiness moved up a level); a.sidebar-link 7.1x (parent align-items: stretch); a.decks-chip absolute padding on a 92px box. ~1.4M tokens (4 auditors x 2 rounds + the judge), session 5 -> 27%.
